command: cat tiles.yaml; kubectl -n geo-17b7 get deploy tiles -o yaml

cd <job>/tmp/k8s/p1runs/s9317b7/cwd; kubectl -n geo-17b7 get svc,pdb,hpa -o wide; sed 's/^  name: tiles$/  name: tiles-tmp/' tiles.yaml > /tmp/tiles-tmp.yaml; grep -n "name: tiles" /tmp/tiles-tmp.yaml
cd <job>/tmp/k8s/p1runs/s9317b7/cwd; kubectl -n geo-17b7 get svc,pdb,hpa -o wide

kubectl -n geo-17b7 apply -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: tiles-tmp
  labels:
    app: tiles-tmp
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: tiles
      scheme: v2
      slot: tmp
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: tiles
        scheme: v2
        slot: tmp
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 2
      containers:
      - name: tiles
        image: busybox:1.36
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        command: ["sh","-c","sleep 6; touch /tmp/ready; exec httpd -f -p 8080"]
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        resources:
          requests: {cpu: 10m, memory: 16Mi}
          limits: {cpu: 200m, memory: 64Mi}
        readinessProbe:
          exec:
            command: ["test","-f","/tmp/ready"]
          periodSeconds: 1
          failureThreshold: 1
EOF
kubectl -n geo-17b7 rollout status deploy/tiles-tmp --timeout=120s
kubectl -n geo-17b7 delete deploy tiles --wait=true && kubectl -n geo-17b7 apply -f <job>/tmp/k8s/p1runs/s9317b7/cwd/tiles.yaml && kubectl -n geo-17b7 rollout status deploy/tiles --timeout=120s
kubectl -n geo-17b7 delete deploy tiles-tmp && kubectl -n geo-17b7 get deploy,pods,endpoints
